notes.title: Princess Evangile On Sale Now!
notes.content:
Princess Evangile from moonstone is on sale now! Order during the first week to get 10% off

This massive moege covers an entire year in great detail, split up over more than 26 different chapters, with tons of event CG covering everything from special events to daily moments, including a lot of exciting things you won't want to miss! There’s also lots of SD sprites, cut-ins, and other screen effects to bring this cute game to life! If you've ever dreamt of spending an entire year surrounded by pretty girls, then this huge game is for you!

Those interested in the adult version can order it from our website,  MangaGamer.com (NSFW) . All orders from MangaGamer come with a free Steam Key as well.
